en.title: Maximum Profit over Runs of Identical Commands
en.description:
Within each original maximal run of identical consecutive characters in the command string, at most k commands can be executed, and other commands may be skipped; choices do not change the original runs. Every command has a positive profit; find the maximum total profit.

The standard I/O, examples, and judging were written independently by CSWork; conventions marked as this site's are not presented as original source constraints.
en.input: The first line contains n k (1≤k≤n≤200000), the second line contains a lowercase command string of length n, and the third line contains n profits (1..10⁹).
en.explanation: Example 1: the a at each end forms its own run, giving profits 1+3; the middle bbb takes 10 and 4, for a total of 18. Example 2: the only run can take at most 1 command, so choose profit 3. Example 3: each of the three original runs has only one command and all can be executed, for a total of 6.
hints: Handle each original run independently, choosing at most k items with the largest profits in that run.
